\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\makeatletter
\newcommand{\reportnode}[1]{\pgfpointanchor{#1}{center}\typeout{NODE #1: \the\pgf@x,\the\pgf@y}}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[xshift=1cm,yshift=2cm] (0,0) -- node (a) {} (2,0);
  \coordinate (p) at (3,1);
  \path[xshift=-1cm] (p) node (b) {};
  \draw[shift={(1,2)}] (0,0) -- node[xshift=2mm,yshift=-1mm] (c) {} (2,0);
  \begin{scope}[rotate=90]
    \draw[xshift=1cm] (0,0) -- node[yshift=2mm] (d) {} (2,0);
  \end{scope}
  \reportnode{a}\reportnode{b}\reportnode{c}\reportnode{d}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
